title: Successor recursion for parity trees
statement: For natural numbers $n,r,t,g$ and $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, the depth-$(t+1)$ parity tree value at index $g$ is the product, over $j=0,\ldots,r-1$, of the depth-$t$ values at indices $gr+j$.
